whole_source_purpose_assessment: The original node is a router absent from the five selectable visual_atom IDs in face compatibility. The frozen validator expressly excludes router/guard IDs from visual evidence and the tag filter hides them, which is substantive evidence of a routing architecture. But that compatibility also requires observable_facial_change AND head_gaze_vector AND scene_context to remain visible. The original action links brow tension, head direction and a paused hand to a sample (KO additionally specifies gaze to an object held in the other hand). These concrete records are separate examples, not this candidate closure. Together they show intended observable cue selection rather than establish that this node is only a storage/check instruction. No verified implementation transfers every positive duty from this definition to a separately evidenced record.
why_prior_all_nonsemantic_basis_is_insuf: The old basis correctly refuses to invent a head angle, eye vector, gaze target or facial movement. It incorrectly treats the lack of those filled values as enough to mark the full positive cue-selection clause nonsemantic. An unfilled conditional cue contract can still impose P/PR/context or selected effects; current facts=[] and one whole-string nonsemantic unit do not represent that possibility.
